# Internal rounding helper
Replace float division inside private _round_minor_units(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> int in billing/math.py using standard-library decimal, to preserve accuracy for large integers. Inputs are validated integers; denominator is positive. Round to the nearest integer, with ties to even, and preserve the existing public API. No IO, external data, permission, schema, or user/operator workflow changes. Reuse the existing helper rather than adding an abstraction. Verification command: python3 -B test_rounding.py. Existing small-number vectors must pass; add zero, negative, half-unit, and large-integer cases. No other decisions are blocking.
files.billing/math.py:
def _round_minor_units(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> int:
    return round(numerator / denominator)
files.test_rounding.py:
from billing.math import _round_minor_units
assert _round_minor_units(1, 2) == 0
assert _round_minor_units(3, 2) == 2
assert _round_minor_units(-3, 2) == -2
